findings.title: Title now takes precedence over id in find, so an id can resolve to the wrong task
findings.why: The lookup order changed from id first to title first. Titles are free text and nothing stops one from looking like an id. If a user adds a task titled "task-1" (the second task, which gets id task-2), then find, complete, remove, rename, tag and untag called with "task-1" act on the task titled "task-1", not the task whose id is task-1. This breaks task-001's requirement that these methods accept a task's id. It also breaks the stable-reference purpose of ids, because an id can silently hit, and `remove` can delete, a different task. Id lookup should come first, or titles that collide with ids should be rejected.
